messages:
Alex B: heads-up — partner asks if we can build an early-adopter credit for SI-led marketplace private offers. they want something to nudge pilot customers into a committed SKU. any objections?
Maria S: 👍 sounds useful. need to make sure credits don’t stack w/ standard promo SKUs.
Julien T: do we mean a one-time credit applied at activation, or an amortized credit across invoices? both have different accounting + renewal impacts.
Priya K: from GTM view, one-time upfront credit is easiest to communicate to SIs. it helps them close pilots. renewal math is messy if we amortize.
Alex B: I was thinking one-time activation credit that unlocks when commit >= threshold within first 60 days. then a smaller renewal credit if they re-commit at 12m.
Elena (Legal): flag: make sure contract language ties credit to committed spend and includes clawback if customer terminates early. also need to cap total credits per account (recommended).
Julien T: rough numbers proposal for proof-of-concept offer for SI bundle: commit bands and credits
marketplace-bot: posted a draft doc: https://rwd.internal/sales/si-early-adopter-v1 (internal)
Julien T: ```json
{
  "sku": "SI-BUNDLE-ADPT",
  "term": "12m",
  "commit_bands": [
    {"min_commit": "$25k", "credit": "$5k"},
    {"min_commit": "$50k", "credit": "$12k"},
    {"min_commit": "$100k", "credit": "$30k"}
  ],
  "activation_window_days": 60,
  "renewal_credit": "$3k (if >= previous commit)",
  "max_total_credit_per_account": "$50k"
}
```
Priya K: that looks sensible. can we make the credit deliverable as marketplace credits (applied toward future invoices) rather than cash? simplifies bookkeeping.
Elena (Legal): marketplace-credit delivery is preferred. update SLA/TOU to reflect non-refundable, non-transferable credit.
Alex B: vendor/hardware partner alignment: VoltCloud wants to co-announce an SI solution with a bundled reserved capacity discount. they asked if their co-marketing contribution can be treated as part of the early-adopter package. thoughts?
Maria S: we can allow partner co-funding but need to reflect it in the private offer terms (separate line item). don't let it increase customer-facing discount beyond cap.
Julien T: operationally, private offers need explicit SKU lines. proposal: create a companion SKU for partner-funded discount: SI-BUNDLE-ADPT-VOLT with partner_funded = true, showing both our credit and partner discount.
Priya K: timeline: if we want to launch a joint announcement with VoltCloud at mid-quarter, we need legal + billing changes done in 3 weeks. is that realistic?
Elena (Legal): 3 weeks is tight but doable if we reuse standard private-offer templates and add the credit appendix. need folks to sign off this week on the credit caps.
Alex B: action items: @Julien draft the private-offer SKU rows, @Priya prep the GTM one-pager and co-announcement timeline, @Maria confirm marketplace UI labeling (credit vs discount), @Elena draft the appendix. i'll run partner ask with VoltCloud.
Julien T: will drop a CSV of SKU lines by tomorrow. example row: `SI-BUNDLE-ADPT, 12M, $50k commit, $12k credit, activation=60d, renewal_credit=$3k`
Priya K: for messaging, emphasize "early-adopter credit + partner co-fund" and "pilot to production path: credits + renewal incentive". keeps story tight for SIs. :mega:
Maria S: UI note — marketplace will show two lines: "Platform credit" and "Partner contribution". users must accept both when completing private offer. backend needs a flag so credits do not auto-apply to other SKUs.
Elena (Legal): also call out audit trail requirements. we need a clause for partner-provided funds and a partner co-funding MOU.
Alex B: budget check — finance, can we limit exposure by only enabling the offer for named accounts (SI referral list) and adding a per-account credit cap as Julien suggested?
Julien T: yes. we can gateability by account_id and add `max_total_credit_per_account` in the private-offer metadata.
marketplace-bot: reminder: private-offer approvals need 48h for marketplace ops review before live.
Priya K: final question — how do we handle renewals that downshift commit? do we claw back portion of original credit?
Elena (Legal): recommended: clawback pro-rata if customer reduces below a minimum commit within first 12 months; optional for renewals beyond 12m. need clear examples in the appendix.
Julien T: implementation note for eng: billing should tag credit with `origin=si_early_adopter_<offer_id>` and store `commit_snapshot` at activation. that enables simple pro-rata calculations later.
Alex B: ok good. i'll sync with VoltCloud next week. target: finalize numbers + legal appendix by EOW, engineering to confirm gating/metadata feasibility. thanks all. 🙏
Priya K: great, i'll start the co-announcement draft and share campaign calendar.
Maria S: will open the marketplace UI ticket and link when done.
Elena (Legal): i'll prepare a redline appendix and circulate for comments.
Julien T: CSV queued for tomorrow.
marketplace-bot: scheduled reminder in 5 days for status update on thread.
